card.name: Part-of-speech tags in dictionary entries
card.fires_on: Part-of-speech labels such as n, noun or adj at the start of a new sense in online dictionary entries. It fires on the label right before the definition text.

modes.label: Abbreviated label
modes.description: The abbreviation n or adj after a dash, starting a new definition.
modes.example: - n. Archaic An evil person. -<< adj>>. Archaic Evil; cruel.

modes.label: Spelled-out noun
modes.description: The ending of the word noun inside parentheses after a headword.
modes.example: keratosis nigricans(n<<oun>>) a skin disease characterized by dark wart

card.writes: It adds little beyond a vague lean toward words meaning form or version.
